description: Import a mine block description from a TAB-delimited text file. Same columns as `massflow mine-block import`, which reads the comma-delimited CSV form.
notes: Not in the MassFlow manual — this command has no page in the 9.7 doc tree. Syntax below is read from the live 9.7.47 binary.
The tab-delimited files shipped with the example projects start with a `Delimiter: r;` line ahead of the header row.
Verified on the tutorial's `mineblocks.txt`: 9696 blocks imported.
File format: see reference topic 'file-formats block-model'.
